hints.title: Even Total Sum Requirement
hints.text: The sum of all node values must be even. If the total sum is odd, no valid equal partition exists.

hints.title: Half Total Target
hints.text: Partitioning requires removing an edge whose disconnected child subtree sums to exactly half of the total tree sum.

hints.title: Exclude Entire Tree Sum
hints.text: Compute subtree sums bottom up. Store subtree sums in a collection, but do not consider the whole tree sum as a cut since removing no edge is invalid.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in the binary tree
complexity.notes: Post-order traversal collecting all subtree sums except the root sum.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating deletion of every edge and summing separated subtrees takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Recording subtree sums in a collection during a single bottom-up traversal runs in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Total tree sum must be even, target is total / 2, and the root itself cannot be the split subtree.
